diagram_previews.alt: Two unit squares: on the left four points forming a shaded convex quadrilateral; on the right three points A, B, C forming a triangle with the fourth point D inside it.

difficulty_rationale: Given the expected triangle area, the key insight is that non-convexity means one point falls inside the triangle of the other three, an event whose probability is that expected area; the four such events are disjoint.
